endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: mo_nps_round_spring_current_river nps-round-spring-middle-river-landing-area: The current NPS Superintendent’s Compendium lists Round Spring (middle) as a Current River landing for floaters and separately lists Round Spring Boat Ramp among launches dedicated to motorized vessels. Keep the stored campsite/area pin as a general Round Spring access anchor, not as the exact boat-ramp or floater-landing coordinate. Route notes should direct paddlers to the signed floater landing and not the motorized ramp.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (mo_nps_round_spring_current_river nps-round-spring-middle-river-landing-area) on Current River; treat the agency parking/carry anchor as on/near-water evidence, but confirm the exact water entry and landing before launch.

endpoints.endpointName: Pulltite Campground / Current River landing (imagery-derived water-entry edge)
endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: nps_ozark_pulltite_landing_aerial_20260918 nps-pulltite-current-river-water-entry: NPS lists Pulltite among popular Upper Current River put-ins and documents the Pulltite-to-Round-Spring float. Current Google Maps aerial imagery shows the County Road EE-356 approach and campground access reaching the Current River at 37.335123,-91.477444. The previous route point 37.33505,-91.47959 was a practical campground-area anchor about 403 feet from mapped water and 485 feet from the matched flowline. The selected water-entry coordinate is imagery-derived with 75-foot uncertainty, not a surveyed NPS point.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the exact named authoritative water-entry control (nps_ozark_pulltite_landing_aerial_20260918 nps-pulltite-current-river-water-entry) on Current River; the 66 ft named-flowline offset reflects incomplete or generalized NHD coverage, not a proposed coordinate move.
